easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
